# BCGov Crow - v0.12.3

## Release type

Patch release

## Summary

Crow Testing now organizes feature scenarios around each repository's own
application structure and provides manual QA guidance that is easier to review,
browse, and run.

## Highlights

- Scenario planning uses evidence-based, reviewer-confirmed feature homes and
  ownership gates, avoiding unapproved category creation or document moves.
- Manual QA guidance provides one browse and release index linked to
  tester-focused checks with reproducible setup, visible outcomes, and
  supporting technical details.
- AI-authored manual details start as Draft. Approved details remain unchanged
  unless a reviewer authorizes a named-document change, which returns the
  content to Draft for review.

## Changes

- Added guidance and a template for deriving and confirming project-specific
  scenario organization, including ownership decisions and cross-application
  feature homes.
- Aligned the Crow Testing agent, skill, workflow, and scenario templates with
  the new organization and manual-document review rules.
- Reworked manual QA templates to separate the browse index from runnable
  checks, use stable check identifiers, and keep technical traceability below
  tester-facing instructions.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: Passed — 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- Package dry run: Passed — 222 files selected; no archive was generated.
- Archive inspection: Not run — no release archive was generated for this draft.
- Additional checks: Version alignment, Crow version/release guard tests,
  reviewed-note candidate workflow tests, and `git diff --check` passed.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.12.3 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.12.3.zip --global --target copilot
```
